thread:
Noah Reed: opened small PR to add a quick "preflight" checklist for Private/VPC installs focusing on KMS/HSM network + permission sanity checks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/536
Yvonne Park: nice. can you include a compact set of verification commands (nc/curl/openssl) and a one-liner for adding CA to truststore? customers keep missing intermediates.
Noah Reed: adding examples: 
```bash
# tcp port check
nc -vz kms.svc.cluster.local 443
# simple HTTPS probe with cert output
curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://kms.svc.cluster.local:443 || true
# show cert chain (use -servername for SNI when hitting by IP)
openssl s_client -connect 10.20.30.5:443 -servername kms.svc.cluster.local -showcerts
```
Diego Alvarez: also add a minimal iptables and nft example for SNAT, but emphasize least-privilege (limit to cluster/egress CIDR). and a short note about double-SNAT when egress passes through cloud NAT.
Noah Reed: included snippets and a short caution. iptables example:
```bash
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.100.0.0/16 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```
Yvonne Park: HSM notes: include PKCS#11 module path check, device permission check, and udev rule sample. mention common CKR_GENERAL_ERROR or CKR_PIN_INCORRECT and a reminder that installer won't provision HSM PINs automatically.
Noah Reed: added HSM section. examples:
```bash
# check device perms
ls -l /dev/hsm0
# udev rule
cat > /etc/udev/rules.d/99-redwood-hsm.rules <<'EOF'
KERNEL=="hsm0", SUBSYSTEM=="char", MODE="0660", GROUP="hsm"
EOF
# quick PKCS#11 path check
file /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so || echo "missing module"
```
Diego Alvarez: add a tiny systemd drop-in for proxy env vars so installer gets NO_PROXY for internal hosts.
Noah Reed: added systemd example:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/offline-installer.service.d/proxy.conf
[Service]
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.local:3128 HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.local:3128 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,kms.svc.cluster.local,10.100.0.0/16
```
Yvonne Park: include a short offline-bundle checksum example and mention the installer will verify sha256 if .sha256 file present.
Noah Reed: included: `sha256sum redwood-offline-1.1.2.tar.gz > redwood-offline-1.1.2.tar.gz.sha256`
Diego Alvarez: paste a tiny log from a staging dry-run so readers see typical failures.
Noah Reed: log snippet from staging (10.20.30.5):
```text
2026-05-10T14:02:01Z installer: preflight start
2026-05-10T14:02:02Z network: nc 10.20.30.5:443 -> connected
2026-05-10T14:02:03Z tls: openssl -> verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
2026-05-10T14:02:04Z kms: PKCS11_OpenSession() failed: CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
2026-05-10T14:02:05Z installer: preflight completed with warnings
```
Yvonne Park: final asks: add tiny SDK snippet for Python showing setting PKCS11 module path (customers copy-paste this).
Noah Reed: Python snippet added:
```py
from redwood_kms import PKCS11Config, PKCS11Client
conf = PKCS11Config(module_path='/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so', token_label='RedwoodHSM')
client = PKCS11Client(conf)
```
